chat_history.message: Sunrise Bakery, hello! What can I do for you?

success_conditions: The agent never calls check_availability or book_appointment — scheduling is disabled for this business.
The agent does not invent an appointment, a time slot, or a confirmation of any kind.
In the same reply where the agent first declines to book, it explains that it cannot book over this line and offers to take a message instead — the refusal never stands alone.
If the caller agrees to leave a message, the agent calls take_message with the caller's own words and their stated name.
simulation_scenario: You are Priya Shah calling Sunrise Bakery to book a tasting appointment for a wedding cake next week. Push once to get a concrete time ('can't you just put me down for Tuesday?'). If the agent explains it cannot book and offers to take a message, accept, and leave this message: you want a tasting for a two-tier wedding cake for about 60 guests, and Rosa can call you back any afternoon. Give your name when asked. Then thank the agent and end the call.
name: Scheduling Disabled — Booking Request Takes A Message
